account.mangroveSectionIntro: Your reviews are signed with a cryptographic keypair. You can import an existing Mangrove Reviews account to use it here, or export yours to back it up.
account.mangroveImportTitle: Sign in to existing Mangrove Reviews account
account.mangroveImportHelp: Paste the JWK private key exported from mangrove.reviews or another client. This replaces your current keypair — all new reviews will be signed with the imported identity.
account.mangroveImportWarning: Any reviews you wrote under the current keypair will become immutable (you can no longer edit or delete them from this account).
account.mangroveImportInvalidJson: Could not parse input as JSON.
account.mangroveImportFailed: Import failed. Check that this is a valid ECDSA P-256 private JWK.
account.mangroveImportLoadedBody: Choose how to protect the imported keypair on this device. Fingerprint: <fp></fp>
account.mangroveExportHelp: This is the signing keypair for your Mangrove Reviews identity. Keep it private — anyone with this key can post reviews as you.
account.mangroveExportWarning: Treat this like a password. Store it in a password manager or secure note.
account.mangroveRegenerateConfirm: This discards your current Mangrove keypair and generates a new one. Reviews signed with the old keypair will remain visible but you will no longer be able to edit or delete them. If you want to keep the old keypair, export it first.
account.mangroveRegenerateFailed: Could not generate a new keypair.
account.mangroveSetupPrompt: You haven't set up your Mangrove Reviews keypair yet. Choose how you want to protect your signing key.
account.mangroveSetupIntro: Your reviews are signed with a cryptographic keypair. Choose how the private key should be protected — this decision is independent of your OpenMapX sign-in.
account.mangrovePassphraseDifferenceTitle: This passphrase is not your account password
account.mangrovePassphraseDifferenceBody: Your OpenMapX sign-in (email, passkey, or OAuth provider) is separate from this Mangrove passphrase. Server admins can never see the Mangrove passphrase, which is what keeps your signing key private even if our database leaks.
account.mangroveModePassphraseSubtitle: Encrypt your keypair with a passphrase you'll remember. You'll enter it before signing a review (with a short grace period).
account.mangroveModePassphraseWebAuthnSubtitle: Recommended. Unlock with your device's biometric (Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello, security key). Passphrase remains as a backup.
account.mangroveModeUnencryptedSubtitle: Your keypair is stored in cleartext on the server. Lowest friction, but anyone with database access can sign reviews as you. Not recommended.
account.mangroveWebAuthnUnavailable: Your browser or device does not support WebAuthn PRF. Use passphrase-only for now.
account.mangroveSetupPassphraseWebAuthnTitle: Set a passphrase and register a passkey
account.mangroveLossWarningTitle: Losing your passphrase means losing control of this keypair
account.mangroveLossWarningBody: There is no password reset. If you forget the passphrase and you have no registered passkey, you can no longer edit or delete reviews signed with this keypair — they stay public but immutable. You can always start over with a fresh keypair.
account.mangrovePassphraseHelper: At least 8 characters. Use something memorable but not one of your other passwords.
account.mangrovePassphraseHelperUnlock: The passphrase you set when creating the keypair.
account.mangrovePassphraseTooShort: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters.
account.mangroveWebAuthnStepTitle: You'll be asked for a passkey next
account.mangroveWebAuthnStepBody: After you continue, your browser will prompt you to approve a passkey ceremony (Face ID, Touch ID, or security key). The passkey's PRF output derives a key that encrypts your Mangrove keypair. The passkey itself is stored on your device.
account.mangroveUnencryptedWarningBody: Without encryption, anyone with database access (admins, attackers after a leak) can sign reviews using your identity or delete your existing reviews. We recommend a passphrase.
account.mangroveUnencryptedAck: Pick this only if friction concerns outweigh security for you — for example, a personal development instance.
account.mangroveUnencryptedBadge: Not encrypted — server sees the signing key
account.mangroveUnencryptedBadgeAlertTitle: Your keypair is stored in cleartext
account.mangroveUnencryptedBadgeAlertBody: Add encryption (passphrase or passkey) to prevent server-side access. Use "Start fresh" below to switch modes.
account.mangroveAddPassphraseHelp: You can unlock with any registered method. Adding another passphrase does not replace existing methods.
account.mangroveChangePassphraseHelp: Pick a new passphrase. Your keypair itself stays the same — only the way it's locked on this server changes.
account.mangroveRemoveLastDisabled: You must keep at least one unlock method.
account.mangroveMustUnlockForChanges: Unlock your keypair to add or remove methods, or to export it.
account.mangroveUnlockIntro: Your Mangrove signing key is encrypted. Unlock it to sign a review.
account.mangroveUnlockFailed: Unlock failed. Check your passphrase or use a passkey.

legal.imprintDescription: Legal notice and provider identification for OpenMapX according to German law.
legal.privacyDescription: Privacy policy for OpenMapX describing how we handle your data in accordance with the GDPR.
legal.termsDescription: Terms of service and conditions of use for OpenMapX.
legal.openSourceLicensesDescription: Open source dependency licenses used by OpenMapX.
legal.supportDescription: How to get help with OpenMapX, and where to find the privacy policy, terms, licenses and account deletion.
legal.supportIntro: OpenMapX is open source and self-hostable. If something is not working, these are the places to look and the ways to reach us.
legal.supportContactBody: Email is the fastest route. Tell us which platform you are on, the app version from Settings, and what you expected to happen.
legal.supportNavigationStops: Guidance stops when the screen locks
legal.supportNavigationStopsBody: The app needs background location permission to keep guiding you with the screen off. Grant "Always" (iOS) or "Allow all the time" (Android) in system settings. Without it the app still works, but guidance pauses when the screen locks.
legal.supportOfflineHeading: The map does not load without a connection
legal.supportOfflineBody: The interface is served from the web, so a cold start with no connection cannot show it. A navigation session you started while online keeps running regardless, and you can still control it from the app's own screen.
legal.supportAlertHeading: The get-off alert did not sound
legal.supportAlertBody: Check that notifications are allowed and that a Focus or Do Not Disturb mode is not silencing them. Some phones also restrict background apps aggressively; allowing OpenMapX to run in the background fixes it.
legal.deleteAccountDescription: Delete your OpenMapX account and the data associated with it, from any browser, whether or not you still have the app installed.
legal.deleteAccountIntro: You can delete your OpenMapX account from this page. You do not need the app installed, and you do not need to reinstall it.
legal.deleteAccountSignedOut: Sign in below, then choose Delete account. You will be asked to confirm, because this cannot be undone.
legal.deleteAccountInApp: You can also do this in the app: open Settings, then Account, then Delete account.
legal.deleteAccountWhatBody: Your account and sign-in details, your saved places and labels, your app settings, and your review signing key. Any navigation session on your device is deleted when you end it or when the app is removed; it was never on our servers.
legal.deleteAccountKeptBody: Reviews you chose to publish are held by Mangrove.reviews, a public review commons, and are not ours to retract. Security and audit records required to keep the service safe and to meet legal obligations are retained for a limited period and are not linked to your account afterwards.
legal.deleteAccountTimingBody: Deletion happens immediately. Backups made before deletion are rotated out within 30 days.

osmContributions.disabledValueTooLong: The current value is longer than OpenStreetMap allows.
osmContributions.evidenceSignage: It is on a sign at the place
osmContributions.evidenceOtherCompatible: Another source I am allowed to use
osmContributions.evidenceOtherDetailHelp: 3 to 120 characters, shown publicly in the changeset.
osmContributions.evidenceWarning: Do not copy from another map, a directory, or a database you do not have permission to use.
osmContributions.removeValueHelp: Use this only when the value is wrong and should no longer exist.
osmContributions.fieldEmptyError: Enter a value, or choose to remove it.
osmContributions.fieldTooLongError: Too long for OpenStreetMap (255 characters maximum).
osmContributions.fieldDisabledError: This field can no longer be changed. Remove or correct it.
osmContributions.reviewCommentHelp: 10 to 255 characters. This becomes the public changeset comment.
osmContributions.reviewRequestLabel: Ask another mapper to review this
osmContributions.reviewRecommended: A category change is worth a second pair of eyes.
osmContributions.publicNotice: You are publishing to OpenStreetMap as {name}. The change, your comment, your source and your edit history are public.
osmContributions.conflictTitle: This place changed while you were editing
osmContributions.conflictBody: Someone else edited this place in OpenStreetMap. Check what changed, then review your correction against the latest data.
osmContributions.noteDisclosure: Notes are public and attributed to your OpenStreetMap account. Describe the map-data problem only, and never include personal or confidential information.
osmContributions.noteNotFeedback: This is not a channel for feedback about OpenMapX.
osmContributions.noteNoLocation: OpenMapX cannot determine a reliable location for this feature, so a note cannot be created here.
osmContributions.successLag: OpenMapX and other map services may take a while to show your change. That is normal.
osmContributions.discardBody: Your unsent changes will be lost.
osmContributions.errorFeatureDisabled: Contributing to OpenStreetMap is not enabled on this instance.
osmContributions.errorDirectEditingDisabled: Direct editing is switched off right now. You can still write a public note.
osmContributions.errorReauthorizationRequired: Authorize OpenMapX with OpenStreetMap again to continue.
osmContributions.errorContributorTerms: Accept the OpenStreetMap Contributor Terms first.
osmContributions.errorAccountBlocked: Your OpenStreetMap account has an active block.
osmContributions.errorElementNotFound: This place no longer exists in OpenStreetMap.
osmContributions.errorElementDeleted: This place has been deleted from OpenStreetMap.
osmContributions.errorElementNotEligible: This place cannot be edited here.
osmContributions.errorFieldNotEditable: That field cannot be changed on this place.
osmContributions.errorInvalidChange: Please check the values you entered.
osmContributions.errorEmptyChange: Change at least one value first.
osmContributions.errorVersionConflict: This place changed in OpenStreetMap while you were editing.
osmContributions.errorSubmissionInProgress: This correction is already being published.
osmContributions.errorRateLimited: Too many contributions. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
osmContributions.errorAmbiguousResult: OpenMapX could not confirm whether your change was applied. Check the links below before trying again.
osmContributions.errorOsmUnavailable: OpenStreetMap is unavailable right now. Your input is kept.
osmContributions.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Your input is kept.

mobileShell.loadErrorBody: Check your internet connection and try again.
mobileShell.offlineBody: OpenMapX needs a connection to load. Any navigation you already started keeps running.
mobileShell.fatalConfigBody: OpenMapX cannot start because its compiled server configuration is invalid. Please reinstall the app.
mobileShell.offlineNavigatingBody: OpenMapX could not load the page, but the navigation you started keeps guiding you. Reconnect to see the map again, or end navigation.
mobileShell.resumeBody: OpenMapX was closed while navigation was running. Location tracking has stopped. Resume to continue, or end this trip.
mobileShell.permissionLostBody: Navigation stopped because OpenMapX no longer has location access. You can grant it again in system settings.
mobileShell.incompatibleTitle: This app version is too old
mobileShell.incompatibleBody: OpenMapX on this device cannot run navigation for the current version of the site. Update the app from the store, or keep planning in the page.
mobileShell.corruptSessionTitle: The previous trip could not be restored
mobileShell.corruptSessionBody: OpenMapX could not read the stored navigation session, so it was discarded. Nothing was sent anywhere. You can start a new trip.
mobileShell.runtimeUpdateRequiredBody: This version of the app is too old for the current map. You can keep searching and planning routes; install the update to start navigation again.
mobileShell.runtimeErrorBody: OpenMapX could not reach the navigation service inside the app. Close and reopen the app to try again.
mobileShell.runtimeModeUnavailable: This app version cannot guide you on this kind of trip yet.

mobilePermissions.title: OpenMapX needs your location to guide you
mobilePermissions.purpose: While navigation is running, OpenMapX uses your precise location to keep guiding you — including when the screen is locked or you switch to another app.
mobilePermissions.processing: Guidance is calculated on this device. Your position is not stored as a location history.
mobilePermissions.transmission: Coordinates may be sent to the OpenMapX server this app is configured for, to fetch a new route, recalculate after a wrong turn, or refresh transit departures.
mobilePermissions.stopping: Tracking stops as soon as you end navigation. You can also revoke access at any time in system settings.
mobilePermissions.precise: Turn-by-turn guidance needs precise location. Approximate location cannot tell which street you are on.
mobilePermissions.foregroundOnlyNote: You can allow location only while the app is open. Guidance then pauses whenever OpenMapX leaves the foreground.
mobilePermissions.settingsBackground: To keep guiding you with the screen locked, choose "Allow all the time" for OpenMapX in system settings.
mobilePermissions.settingsPrecise: Turn on precise location for OpenMapX in system settings, then come back.
mobilePermissions.settingsCannotEscalate: OpenMapX can no longer ask for this permission. Grant it for OpenMapX in system settings, then come back.
mobilePermissions.deniedBody: OpenMapX cannot guide you without location access. You can still plan routes and browse the map.
mobilePermissions.foregroundOnlyPausedBody: You allowed location only while OpenMapX is open, so guidance paused when the app left the foreground. Open OpenMapX to continue.

mobileAuth.title: Sign in to OpenMapX
mobileAuth.purposeSignIn: Continue to sign in to the OpenMapX app.
mobileAuth.purposeLinkProvider: Continue to link this account to the OpenMapX app.
mobileAuth.purposeAddPasskey: Continue to add a passkey for the OpenMapX app.
mobileAuth.signInFirst: Sign in on this page first, then continue to return to the app.
mobileAuth.failed: Sign-in could not be completed. Close this page and try again in the app.
mobileAuth.invalidRequest: This sign-in link is not valid. Start again from the OpenMapX app.
mobileAuth.openInBrowserBody: This version of the app cannot carry the sign-in back automatically. You can sign in on the website, but you will need to sign in again in the app after updating.
mobileAuth.systemAuthFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
